notes: Reached via Chrome connector, no Cloudflare/anti-bot wall encountered (unlike the prior Home-Decor pass which needed translate.goog; a real browser session hit the site directly with HTTP 200 throughout). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. The prior pass's notes flagged an entire 'Furniture nav panel (Seating, Beds, Tables, Storage, Shop by Room)' that it deliberately excluded from scope -- this pass extracts exactly that panel. Tree source: the site's own mega-menu under the top-level FURNITURE nav item, read from the DOM (header/nav <a> tags), which resolves into 4 type-based groups -- SEATING, BEDS, TABLES, STORAGE -- each with its own children; every leaf's breadcrumb (e.g. 'Home / Furniture / Seating / Sofa', 'Home / Furniture / Tables / Trolley') confirms the grouping. sitemap_collections_1.xml returned HTTP 400 on every fetch attempt (server-side, not a bot block -- robots.txt and the homepage both loaded fine over the same session) so the mega-menu + a site-search discrimination check served as the cross-check instead of the sitemap: /search/suggest.json returned 0 products for wardrobe, recliner, tv-unit, almirah and nightstand (furniture types Freedom Tree does not carry) while returning non-zero for sofa/chair (proving the search endpoint discriminates, not a blanket empty-result bug), so no furniture branch is believed missing from the mega-menu. qty for every leaf = unique product ID count from that collection's own /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (rule-3 full enumeration; page=2 returned 0 items on every collection, confirming no overflow past the 250 cap -- collections here max out at 30). Corroborated per rule 4 against the rendered storefront header on two collections of very different size: /collections/sofa showed 26 Products (matched products.json's 26 exactly) and /collections/trolley showed 2 Products (matched products.json's 2 exactly) -- no discrepancy found, so products.json was trusted for the rest without re-checking each one individually (efficiency rule: two independent confirmations are enough). Excluded per Sec 3 (view-all/roll-up rules): 'FURNITURE' top nav link -> /collections/explore-all-furniture (explore-all roll-up), 'Living Room' -> /collections/living-room-furniture, 'Dining Room' -> /collections/dining-room-furniture and 'Home Office' -> /collections/study-room-furniture (room-based aggregator views that cross-list the same type-based products already captured under Seating/Beds/Tables/Storage -- keeping both would double-report qty against the same catalogue), and 'Ready to Ship Furniture' -> /collections/furniture-design (a shipping-status/promo roll-up, not a product-type category). Everything outside the Furniture nav panel (Home decor, Clothing, Dining & Entertaining, Decor & Lighting, textiles, Sale, Gifts) is out of scope for this task and was not touched.
